## The Wire

```{r editions-margin}
#| results: asis
source("scripts/shared.R")

# Quick links to the class newspaper's editions, kept in the right margin.
newspaper <- load_intake_editions()

if (nrow(newspaper) > 0 && all(c("Edition", "Link") %in% names(newspaper))) {
  eds <- newspaper |> filter(!is.na(Link) & Link != "")
  if (nrow(eds) > 0) {
    eds <- eds[rev(seq_len(nrow(eds))), ]  # newest first
    items <- sprintf(
      '<li><a href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener">%s</a>%s</li>',
      eds$Link,
      ifelse(grepl("^[0-9]+$", eds$Edition), paste("Edition", eds$Edition), eds$Edition),
      ifelse(is.na(eds$Date) | eds$Date == "", "", paste0(" · ", eds$Date))
    )
    cat('::: {.column-margin}\n',
        '<div class="margin-editions"><span class="margin-label">Class Newspaper</span><ul>',
        paste(items, collapse = ""),
        '</ul></div>\n',
        ':::\n', sep = "")
  }
}
```

Live dispatches from the press corps — newest first.

```{r press-links}
#| results: asis
pw <- form_url("Posts"); pe <- form_url("Editions")
links <- c(
  if (!is.na(pw)) sprintf('<a href="%s">Post to the Wire</a>', pw),
  if (!is.na(pe)) sprintf('<a href="%s">Publish an edition</a>', pe)
)
if (length(links) > 0)
  cat('<p class="table-note">', paste(links, collapse = " · "), '</p>', sep = "")
```

## The Papers

```{r outlets}
#| results: asis
# The outlet directory as tiles: each paper's FULL name as its
# nameplate, in journalist purple (the role's canonical color), type
# sized to the name's length. A tile links to the outlet's article page
# when a Link is set; until then it stands as a nameplate.
news <- tryCatch(read.csv(JOURNALIST_CSV), error = function(e) data.frame())

if (nrow(news) > 0) {
  tiles <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(news)), function(i) {
    outlet <- news$Newspaper[i]
    size <- if (nchar(outlet) <= 12) "1.35rem"
            else if (nchar(outlet) <= 20) "1.12rem" else "0.98rem"
    inner <- sprintf('<span class="tile-title" style="font-size:%s">%s</span>',
                     size, outlet)

    link <- news$Link[i]
    if (!is.na(link) && link != "") {
      sprintf('<a class="tile paper" href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener">%s</a>', link, inner)
    } else {
      sprintf('<div class="tile paper" title="Articles coming soon">%s</div>', inner)
    }
  }, character(1))

  cat('<div class="tile-grid">', paste(tiles, collapse = "\n"), '</div>')
} else {
  cat("Newspaper list not available yet.\n")
}
```

<p class="table-note">These outlets are role-played by students in a course
simulation. Everything published under their names — wire posts, editions,
and any accounts or materials students create elsewhere — is fictional
classwork, not the reporting of the real newspapers.</p>
